answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake tied to one auditable thread of its completed jobs, payments, and disputes. New identities start with a tiny trade limit that rises only as that thread proves reliable delivery, like a walnut that must be cracked open by real work before its value is released. To launch a gale of fake agents, an attacker must fund a separate stake for each identity, wait out the slow ramp, and forfeit every bond when an identity cheats, so mass fakery costs far more than it gains.
